text.en: Deep Learning for Tabular Data is row 74 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Deep Learning for Tabular Data 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 74 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Deep Learning for Tabular Data with “Tabular Data: Deep Learning is Not All You Need”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Deep Learning for Tabular Data 与论文《Tabular Data: Deep Learning is Not All You Need》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Ravid Shwartz-Ziv, Amitai Armon”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Ravid Shwartz-Ziv（官方页拼写）、Amitai Armon（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Ravid Shwartz-Ziv, Amitai Armon”。
